findings.location: Article paragraphs 18, 20, 21, and 27: Scripture quotations in <em> elements
findings.source_quote: “...it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye...” (Mar 9:47); “...the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit...” (1Pe 3:4-5); “...woe to that [wo]man by whom the offence cometh!” (Mat 18:7); “Who is a wise [wo]man and endued with knowledge...” (Jas 3:13); “...that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts...” (Tit 2:12).
findings.suggested_fix: The Scripture evidence contains no quote entries for these printed quotations, and the selection audit contains no selections. Supply the required approved evidence for each quotation, then replace only the quoted wording with the exact corresponding target_verses text, preserving partial-quote scope, ellipses, reference identity and placement. Do not invent or expand Scripture wording.
findings.translation_quote: «… det er bedre for deg å gå inn i Guds rike med ett øye …» (Mark 9:47); «… den milde og stille ånds uforgjengelige pryd …» (1 Pet 3:4–5); «… ve det mennesket som forårsaker fallet!» (Matt 18:7); «Hvem er vis og forstandig blant dere? …» (Jak 3:13); «… at vi skal fornekte ugudelighet og verdslige lyster …» (Tit 2:12).
